title: nan
authors: Vanegas F.; Roberts J.; Gonzalez F.
key_contribution: Presents a POMDP-based UAV motion planning approach for tracking mobile targets in occluded, cluttered, GPS-denied environments, validated in simulation.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
